meta.name: learn
meta.description: Distill a reusable skill from anything — a directory, a URL, pasted notes, or what you just did together — or refine an existing skill with new learnings. Use when the user says '/learn', 'learn this', 'turn this into a skill', 'capture this workflow', 'make a skill from <source>', or 'improve/update the <name> skill'. Produces or updates a .claude/skills/<name>/SKILL.md authored to NanoClaw's skill guidelines. (This CREATES or REFINES a skill from a source; it does not install existing skills from a registry.)

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从任何来源提炼或改进可复用的技能
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要把操作流程固化为可复用的技能
copy.tagline_en: Distill or refine a reusable skill from any source
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to turn workflows into reusable skills

howto.what: 把目录、网址、粘贴的笔记或这次对话内容整理成一个可复用的技能,生成 .claude/skills/<名字>/SKILL.md;如果已有同名技能,会就地更新它。
howto.when: 当你说“/learn”“learn this”等指令,或要求“把XX做成技能”“更新XX技能”时触发。

say.note: 会把本次对话的步骤提炼成技能。

say.text: 把这个网址做成一个技能
say.note: 会抓取页面并生成用法技能。

say.text: 更新一下 my-skill 技能
say.note: 会读取现有 SKILL.md 并融入新内容。

howto.what_en: Turns a directory, URL, pasted notes, or the current conversation into a reusable skill, producing .claude/skills/<name>/SKILL.md; if a skill with that name already exists, it updates it in place.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say '/learn', 'learn this', etc., or ask to turn something into a skill or update an existing skill.

say_en.note: Distills this conversation's steps into a skill.

say_en.text: Turn this URL into a skill
say_en.note: Fetches the page and generates a usage skill.
Reads the current SKILL.md and merges new learnings.
